entries.description: Spending firewall for AI agents on NEAR. Lets an agent check its budget and ask to pay from an owner's vault; an on-chain policy, optional TEE risk oracle and the owner decide whether funds move.
representativeQueries: let my AI agent pay on NEAR with spending limits
stop prompt injection from draining an agent's wallet
MCP tool to pay with human approval for large payments
check an AI agent's remaining budget
